service.method: SELECT USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.PLANT_CODE , USMT.DEPT , USMT.POSITION , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.USER_NAME_ENG , USMT.LANGUAGE , USMT.MANAGER_POSITION , USMT.PROFILE_ATTACHE_NO , ADDR.EMAIL , ADDR.PHONE_NO1 , ADDR.PHONE_NO2 , ADDR.FAX_NO , ADDR.ZIP_CODE , ADDR.ADDRESS_LOC , ADDR.ADDRESS_ENG FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADDR ON ADDR.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND ADDR.CODE_NO = USMT.USER_ID WHERE USMT.USER_ID = ${session.ID} AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}
